When the company announces a strict ban on office romance, a dedicated employee realizes her growing feelings for her direct manager could put both of their careers at risk. In the end, he decides to reveal the truth and request a transfer, accepting the professional consequences so they can finally be together without hiding.

figma.text:
When the company announces a strict ban on office romance, a dedicated employee realizes her growing feelings for her direct manager could put both of their careers at risk. After a late-night elevator incident brings them unexpectedly close, they begin dating in secret, hiding their relationship behind professional distance, coded messages, and discreet meetings outside the office. As rumors spread and they are nearly caught together, her manager becomes colder in public to protect them, creating tension and doubt between them. Their worst fear comes true when HR launches an investigation following an anonymous report, forcing them to choose between their careers and their relationship. In the end, he decides to reveal the truth and request a transfer, accepting the professional consequences so they can finally be together without hiding.

Sophie: A careful and detailed office worker who is deeply in love with her manager, constantly trying to balance her career with her secret passion.
The Manager: A disciplined, restrained leader who lets his guard down only when alone with Sophie, desperately trying to protect her and their career.
HR Officer: A vigilant HR representative who strictly enforces the company's no-dating policy and watches employees closely.
Coworker: An overly curious colleague who frequently wanders the halls and almost catches Sophie and the Manager in their private moments.

A drenched courier collapses through the lighthouse threshold just as the keeper bolts the door against the howling blizzard.

The emergency radio broadcasts an urgent alert tracing the courier's priority satchel back to a harbor incident the keeper fled years ago.

【The Broken Lock】
With the satchel's torn seal visible on the table, the keeper blocks the stairway and demands she choose whether to open it together before daybreak.

• Nora Ellis — Coastal courier stranded during an emergency maritime transit
